Description
APPLE INC has the following available in Cupertino, California and various unanticipated locations throughout the USA. Coordinate with multiple cross functional teams to validate and compute optimal operating voltages for different Soc (System on Chips). Use Jmp Pro 17 to process the data from different teams, conduct statistical analyses and use the software to plot relevant graphs that help the team to reach conclusions on different engineering decisions related to testing. Support other teams to come up with test plans for different SoC's. Perform measurements that directly impact Soc power & performance for various next generation products. Work on groundbreaking technologies & new designs and collaborate with multiple multifunctional teams including design, validation, test, manufacturing, system test & software to identify issues and implement corrective actions. Work closely with ATE and software teams to identify & develop case tests, benchmarks to be used in production testing, and characterization. Characterize multiple test setups, correlating to ATE and optimize production screening guard band for each system individually. Define characterization plans, perform statistical data analysis and drive correlation & data reviews across multiple cross-functional teams and sign off on all silicon characterization activities. Multi-task and manage multiple programs at different stages. Act as the central point of contact for multiple teams with direct impact on product. 40 hours/week. At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $149,987 - $218,000/yr and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. 

PAY & BENEFITS: Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits: https://www.apple.com/careers/us/benefits.html.
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

Minimum qualifications
Master’s degree or foreign equivalent in Electrical Engineering or related field.

Experience and/or education must include:

Utilizing strong technical understanding of electrical engineering & semiconductor concepts (Vmin, Power, Impact of Temp / Aging etc).
Utilizing knowledge of data exploration, statistical analysis, and summarization skills
SRAM / Memory design, test and characterization fundamentals
Logic design, state machines, processor building blocks and logic testing
Strong fundamentals of PDN, Signal/Power Integrity and Impact on Vmin / LVCC
Using programming/scripting language: Python, Perl, or JSL, etc
Low Pass Filter Design
Micro and nano fabrication Technologies
Circuit schematic and layout design
PERC (Programmable Electrical Rules Check)

Preferred qualifications
N/A
